question: A square loop of side $10 \text{ cm}$ and resistance $0.5 \, \Omega$ is placed vertically in the East-West plane. A uniform magnetic field of $0.10 \text{ T}$ is set up across the plane in the North-East direction. Determine the magnetic flux linked with the loop.
